subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same drop policy as prompt-send sanitization for aborted assistant tool-call turns that have no real tool result?
rationale: The code can mechanically remove the invalid pair, but choosing between discarding interrupted context and representing it with a synthetic result is durable session-recovery policy rather than a purely technical correction.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Keep the branch's policy so aborted resultless turns are removed before compaction reaches a strict provider, matching the existing prompt-send sanitizer.

options.title: Require synthetic-result semantics
options.body: Pause this PR and define a provider-safe, clearly labeled synthetic-result contract if preserving interrupted-turn context is more important than avoiding fabricated tool output.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Keep the branch's policy so aborted resultless turns are removed before compaction reaches a strict provider, matching the existing prompt-send sanitizer.
